items.title: Dry Cold - 3D enviroment
items.description: I created this 3D environment in Blender for use in film projects. It's inspired by a post-apocalyptic image with a cold atmosphere and blue tones, perfect for content related to snowy landscapes.

items.title: Base 71
items.description: A 3D structural model with a dark atmosphere, perfect for science fiction cinematics.

items.title: The gray wolf - voxel model
items.description: I modeled and animated this voxel model in Blender, from creating the voxels to shaping them, to rigging and animation.

items.title: Abstract ocean
items.description: A render of a representation showing what it would be like if existence were designed to be perfectly bad, but in space, near the walls, a light strong enough to change the paradigm and turn that darkness into light originated.

items.title: Little Fury
items.description: Another character joining my dark universe arrives in a stylized form.

items.title: Ocean corridor
items.description: A 3D structural liminal space representing a corridor in the ocean, with warm tones.

items.title: Escalators - liminal space
items.description: I modeled this liminal space in Blender, from the room to the escalators.

items.title: The infinite building
items.description: A 3D space that I modeled and animated for one of my short films.

items.title: A realistic animation of a giant spider.
items.description: I modeled and animated this scene with the hope of one day making a full short film out of it.
